title: LinkedInPostGeneratorContent
description: Structured-output contract for the LLM copy call (Task B3). This is the ONLY portion produced by the LLM. The server wrapper (and the Codex run) assemble the remaining result.json fields — schemaVersion, generatedAt, inputs echo, colorPair, template, paths, render — around this object. The LLM MUST NOT emit those wrapper-owned fields. The eyebrow label `kicker` IS produced by the LLM (part of this schema) and is a thematic label, never the raw role/industry input. bodyVariant is dictated by the selected template (template.bodyVariant) and passed into the prompt — the LLM must return exactly that body form.

headlineHtml.description: Headline; MAY contain only / pairs, nothing else.

headlinePlain.description: Headline with all HTML tags stripped. Must not contain '<' or '>'.

bodyVariant.description: Dictated by the selected template (template.bodyVariant), NOT derived from tone. The prompt passes the required value — return exactly that. 'bullets' = three bullets; 'insight' = one free-text paragraph.

insight.description: Plain text only, no HTML tags. Non-null iff bodyVariant === 'insight'.

highlight.description: Optional focal emphasis line (≤ 160 chars, plain text, no HTML). Provide a non-null value ONLY when the prompt says the template supports a highlight (insight templates); otherwise return null. Must not repeat the headline verbatim and must respect the same forbidden-phrase rules.

kicker.description: Short eyebrow/kicker label for the pill above the headline. 1-3 words, <= 32 chars, plain text (no HTML), in the post locale. A thematic CATEGORY/rubric derived from the topic AND the content you generate (e.g. 'Preisverhandlung', 'Sichtbarkeit & Vertrauen'). It is NOT the role/industry input — never copy the 'Role or industry' value verbatim — and must NOT restate the headline. Same forbidden-phrase rules as the other fields.

body.description: Caption body without the trailing hashtag line. Paragraphs separated by '\n\n'. LF only — no '\r'. First paragraph MUST be a standalone hook <= 140 chars (enforced by the skill quality gate, see SKILL.md section 9).

items.description: Hashtag WITHOUT leading '#'. Last element MUST be 'LinkedIn' (positional rule enforced by the skill quality gate).
